headline: Fisherman's Row Joins Weathered Expanse in Fresh Strongpoint Fighting
war_summary: Since the earlier bulletin, Fisherman's Row has burst into action, recording eight strategic-base shifts within the latest two-hour watch and ten within six; its one-day total has climbed to thirty-two. Weathered Expanse stays the busiest theatre, with four shifts in the last two hours, ten in six, and thirty-nine on the day. Farranac Coast and Callahan's Passage also show fresh movement in the latest two-hour returns; at Callahan's Passage, Crumbling Post has fallen to neutral ground. Stlican Shelf has cooled further—none in the latest two hours, two in six, but a twenty-four-hour count of twenty-eight. Godcrofts, an earlier centre of change, has been quiet for more than nine hours. Heavy casualties continue at Weathered Expanse, Callahan's Passage, Farranac Coast, Mooring County, and Stonecradle. Neither side has reached the thirty-four victory towns, and the campaign remains undecided.
